scope_policy.context_identity: (project, commit, context, path); Lean repository bytes encode project@context injectively for the fixed registry
scope_policy.external_reason: Pinned GN generates these two outputs under root_gen_dir. They are absent from complete pinned source trees; their GN, generators and templates are bound configs. All four source events remain explicit. This source corpus is not closed over build-generated files.
scope_policy.query_selection: Compute complete independent reverse answers for all roots. Sort cross-project roots by (-number of projects,-answer size,identity), select positions 0,floor(length/2),length-1. Then sort all roots by (answer size,identity), select first unused root at or cyclically after positions 0,floor(length/2),length-1. Freeze six distinct roots before any proof measurements.
scope_policy.selection: All regular committed .mojom in every complete listed module, including tests, plus least closure of committed literal imports; complete Electron plugin and web_contents_utility GN targets; complete Brave AI Chat Mojom GN target
scope_policy.shared_context_equivalence: Only the complete unchanged Electron/Brave import closure of the Stage8 accepted GN targets maps to upstream. Other Chromium files claim upstream context only, regardless of application patches or overlays.
